author: UltraEm
quote:
Honestly, what a waste of time. The graphics are decent, but everything else feels like a massive downgrade. The loading screens take forever, the missions are boring, and the story feels like it was written by someone who just discovered video games yesterday.
Rockstar spent years making this game, and somehow managed to make waiting for GTA 7 more entertaining than playing GTA 6.
The only realistic thing about this game is how unrealistic the price. Biggest disappointment of the decade.

author: UltraEm
quote:
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is one of the greatest video games ever made. From the moment you step into the world of Hyrule, you're taken on an unforgettable adventure filled with mystery, exploration, memorable characters, and incredible dungeons (We are not talking about the Water Temple.).

The open world feels magical, with every location offering something new to discover. The puzzles are clever, the boss fights are memorable, and the soundtrack is absolutely iconic. Playing melodies on the Ocarina is one of the most unique and charming mechanics in gaming.

What makes this game truly special is its atmosphere and storytelling. The journey from childhood to adulthood gives the adventure emotional depth, while the world itself feels alive and full of secrets.

Of course, some controls and mechanics have aged a little, but that doesn't take away from the incredible experience.

Verdict: 10/10.

Ocarina of Time isn't just a great Zelda game. It's a landmark in gaming history and a timeless adventure that every gaming fan should experience at least once.
